title: secrets-veil fails closed: no unmasked result, even before session.start
description: Even if the veil is switched on or reloaded in the middle of a session, a token in a command's output is still covered before Claude reads it. tool.call arms the table on the spot with the same named reads; if those fail it uses value shapes and entropy alone; if a result cannot be masked at all it is withheld with { deny }. A result is never passed through.
